met_analysis:
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south Tamil Nadu coast at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Comorin area to North Interior Karnataka now runs from the above the cyclonic circulation over at Gulf of Mannar & adjoining south Tamil Nadu coast to North Interior Karnataka across interior Tamil Nadu and South Interior Karnataka at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over central parts of Odisha at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from north Rajasthan to cyclonic circulation over central parts of Odisha across northern parts of Madhya Pradesh at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Bangladesh & neighbourhood lies over Gangetic West Bengal & adjoining north Bangladesh extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough now runs from northeast Bihar to Tripura across Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Bangladesh at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Haryana & neighbourhoodat 1.5 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from the above cyclonic circulation over Haryana & neighbourhoodto coastal Bangladesh across Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand and Gangetic West Bengal at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level has merged with above trough.
The Western Disturbance over north Pakistan & neighbourhood now lies over Jammu & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Thailand & neighbourhood extending upto 7.6 km above mean sea level persists. it is likely to emergence in Andaman Sea around 11th October.
